notes: CPU temperature and package power: root cause was the sensor service lacking administrator permission, not a missing third-party tool. Fixed by elevating the sensor service. Every place that told users to install/configure HWiNFO for this…

Fixed a bug where that same sensor-readiness advisory text could get frozen from an old scan and keep reappearing on every app relaunch even after the underlying issue was fixed in code - it was being cached to disk and replayed verbatim…

Fixed the actual cause of "rescan once it's running" showing up on a normal first scan: the sensor bridge is a native process that gets spawned at scan time, and the app only gave it a blind 1.8-second head start before checking readiness.…

System Scan (Settings and first-run): removed the repeated "Available: Model, Load, Clock..." listing on every fully-ready sensor card - it added nothing over the green Ready badge and just forced re-reading the same confirmed fields on…

System Scan (Settings and first-run): consolidated all laptop-specific facts (Manufacturer, Model, Battery) into one dedicated Laptop section instead of splitting them across two separate cards, the same way a desktop would get one…
